review_response_tasks.stem: After lunch, please ____ these cups: put them in their box.
review_response_tasks.rationale: 后文明确要求把杯子放进盒子，put away表示收好。A唤醒不能用于此处杯子收纳；C脱下/起飞不表达放进盒子。

review_response_tasks.stem: The bus leaves at 8:00 and arrives at 8:30. It leaves ____ eight, and the journey takes ____ minutes.
review_response_tasks.rationale: 具体钟点前用at，8:00到8:30为30分钟，A两项同时成立；B把钟点介词误为in；C的60分钟与明确时间差冲突。两个空合为一次选择。

review_response_tasks.stem: I have one brother. This blue coat belongs to him. It is ____, not ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: belongs to him明确所有人为兄弟，独立作表语用his；not后没有名词，用mine。A的my缺后接名词；B的him是宾格，不是所有格。两个空合为一次选择。

review_response_tasks.stem: Our school play starts next Friday. I ____ ready by then.
review_response_tasks.rationale: by then指向明确的未来演出时间，will be ready表示届时准备好。A的was是过去时，与该未来时间不合；C的will have后不能直接用形容词ready充当完整谓语，此处没有宾语。

review_response_tasks.stem:
—Thank you for carrying my heavy bag.
—____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A直接回应感谢；B为迟到致歉，题面无迟到信息且未回应谢意；C为生日祝福，题面无生日信息。仅在所给候选内比较最佳回应。

response_protocol: one printed A/B/C per independent task;double gaps one compound label;no free prose
pre_freeze_editorial_corrections: put away before full noun phrase;do not insert put away before pronoun them
future adjective predicate removes optional prop-possession reading
